description: USD/JPY 1-minute bid/ask reference candles (Dukascopy) used for validation in the FX carry study (docs referenced from scripts/research_fx_carry.py), plus GMO Coin's actually-published USD/JPY margin-FX swap-point calendar used to compute realistic overnight carry cost/income in the same study.
source: USDJPY_1m.csv: Dukascopy historical 1-minute bid data, 2023-01-01 onward (validation series for scripts/research_fx_carry.py's carry-as-income study). gmo_swap_usdjpy.csv: GMO Coin's published USD/JPY swap calendar (swapBuy/swapSell in JPY per 10,000 USD notional, swapDays), 2023-04 onward -- see scripts/research_fx_carry.py header comment for the exact provenance and field mapping.
retention: data/fx/USDJPY_1m.csv is the live working copy, appended forward; backtest_data/fx_usdjpy_1m_<date>.csv.gz is a permanent dated snapshot of it (same columns, verified). backtest_data/gmo_swap_usdjpy.csv is itself the permanent snapshot used by the carry study -- see docs referenced in scripts/research_fx_carry.py for whether/how it is refreshed.

volume.meaning: Dukascopy's own tick-volume proxy for the bar
volume.unit: as provided by source (not a true traded notional -- Dukascopy is an ECN aggregator, not a single venue)

ask_close.meaning: ask close (companion to the bid-based open/high/low/close)
ask_close.notes: blank on rows where the ask series had no print for this minute

volume.meaning: Dukascopy's own tick-volume proxy for the bar

ask_close.notes: blank on rows where the ask series had no print for this minute

date.meaning: calendar date the swap applies to

swap_buy.meaning: swap points credited/charged for a long (buy) USD/JPY position
swap_buy.notes: sign convention: can be negative (a cost) or positive (income) depending on the rate differential at the time

swap_sell.meaning: swap points credited/charged for a short (sell) USD/JPY position

swap_days.meaning: number of days the swap covers (>1 over weekends/holidays, when multiple days' swap is charged at once)
swap_days.notes: scripts/research_fx_carry.py filters swap_days > 0 before computing a per-day bps rate

known_defects: USDJPY_1m.csv volume is an ECN tick-volume proxy, not a real traded notional -- do not treat zero_volume flags on this file as a liquidity signal the way they would be for an exchange trade feed
ask_close is a late addition alongside the original bid OHLC -- earlier rows in the accumulated history may have this column blank even where bid data is present

gmo_swap_usdjpy.csv reflects ONE broker's (GMO Coin) published swap calendar; other brokers' swap points differ and are not cross-checked here -- see scripts/research_fx_carry.py's pre-registration notes for how this choice was justified
